settings.model-intro: The model a new conversation starts on, and agents run on when none is chosen for them.
settings.model-chosen-help: Members can still pick another model in the assistant. If this provider is disconnected, the oldest connected one is used.
settings.model-automatic-help: Automatic uses the recommended model of the AI provider connected first. Members can still pick another model in the assistant.
settings.no-provider-description: Connect OpenAI, Anthropic or another AI provider in Integrations. The assistant and agents run on it.
settings.code-mode-intro: This applies to every member, and to apps connected through the MCP server, whose programs only read. Off by default.
settings.code-mode-description: For questions over many records, the assistant writes a short program that reads through the API and computes totals, shares and comparisons, then answers with the result.
settings.code-mode-fact-api: Only search and call the API, as the member who asked and within their role.
settings.code-mode-fact-time: It stops after 10 seconds or 200 API calls, and returns at most 20,000 characters.
settings.code-mode-fact-sandbox: It runs in an isolated JavaScript sandbox on this server, with 32 MB of memory and no network, files or timers.

appearance.title: Assistant appearance
appearance.intro: How the assistant looks to you, on every device. Other members choose their own.
